paragraphs: Data Ticket handles records and collection of unpaid debt for public agencies, including cities, counties, universities, and colleges. The company describes itself as a California corporation founded in 1989.

Its citation processing product is fully web based. A separate issuance product is aimed at faster citation writing with fewer errors. A permit product supports unlimited permit types and is configurable to an agency's needs. Code enforcement rounds out the set and is described as the first of its kind in California.

The site states that more than 450 clients have been served across the United States. Client size varies widely, with the largest processing 360,000 citations. Work is described as tailored to each client's specific needs.
